plan.title: District Health Comparison
plan.subtitle: Key health indicators across districts in Bihar, Jharkhand, and Odisha

panels.title: Total districts covered
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "District") AS n FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "District" != 'State Total'

panels.title: Vaccination coverage by district
panels.sql: SELECT "District", AVG("Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)") AS avg_vaccinated FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "District" != 'State Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Stunting trends by survey round
panels.sql: SELECT "Survey Round", AVG("Children under 5 years who are stunted (%)") AS avg_stunted FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "District" != 'State Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 districts by stunting rate
panels.sql: SELECT "District", AVG("Children under 5 years who are stunted (%)") AS stunting_rate FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "District" != 'State Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard compares key health indicators across districts in three states. {{p1}} districts are analyzed, with vaccination coverage showing significant variation ({{p2.avg_vaccinated}}). Stunting rates have shown trends across survey rounds ({{p3.avg_stunted}}), and the top 10 districts with highest stunting rates are listed ({{p4.stunting_rate}}).
